text:
Avery (Hiring Manager): New Sr PM starts Mon. Can we lock a short manager-facing playbook I can paste into the welcome DM? Need: day-by-day week1, quick 30/60/90 bullets, and a tiny manager expectations blurb.
Renee (People Ops): Sure 3 here's a compact playbook you can copy. Kept it goal-oriented and manager-friendly.
Dylan (IT): I'll start device + SSO once you DM the email and timezone. Note: VPN/HSM may add 3-5 days.
Hana (Buddy): Happy to buddy. I can do a 45-min product overview day1 and a 90-min pairing session day2.
Cam (HR): Payroll + benefits link will be in the Day0 welcome DM. Security training must be completed in first 5 days.
Renee (People Ops): Playbook (pasteable):
```
Week 0 / Week 1 manager playbook
Pre-day (before start): confirm laptop type & shipping, email + SSO invite, add to team calendar events
Day 0: HR forms + benefits link, Slack intro message, confirm access to email/Slack
Day 1: 60-min product walkthrough (manager + buddy), access check (repos, staging, analytics), schedule recurring 1:1s
Day 2: assign a small discovery task (scoped, deliverable by EOW), pair with buddy for setup and first PR
Day 3: stakeholder intros (30m each) + quick metrics tour
Day 4: collect early feedback, align on 30/60/90 expectations, set measurable success signals
End of week: 30-day goals doc shared; manager provides written 30/60/90 draft and quick feedback check-in
```
Avery (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can you give me a 3-line 30/60/90 I can DM?
Renee (People Ops): 30/60/90 quick bullets:
- 30 days: understand product flows, complete onboarding checklist, deliver a scoped discovery note
- 60 days: own a backlog area, run at least one cross-team sync, ship first independent PRs
- 90 days: lead a small project from planning to launch, demonstrate measurable improvement on target metric
Dylan (IT): Device order placed. ETA 3 business days. Will send SSO invite today. If they need instant access I'll provision a temporary cloud dev env.
Hana (Buddy): Quick who-to-ask cheat: repo perms -> Cam (Eng Ops), staging -> #qa, deploys -> Eng Lead (Sam), analytics -> Data Eng (Lee). I'll paste into the doc.
Cam (HR): Manager expectations (short): weekly 1:1 for first 8 weeks, clear ownerable milestones for 30/60/90, defined decision boundaries, and two formal check-ins at weeks 2 and 6.
Renee (People Ops): Also add these three success signals (manager copyable):
- 30: delivered a discovery doc + one suggested next-step
- 60: independently runs syncs and merges PRs with minimal review cycles
- 90: owned a release or shipped a measurable improvement
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "New hire Day0 welcome" 2024-06-24 09:30.
Avery (Hiring Manager): Perfect. I'll paste this into the offer follow-up and the #new-hires template. Renee  can you attach the manager checklist to the template library?
Renee (People Ops): Done 3 added as "mgr-compact-playbook" in templates and shared with hiring managers. I'll DM the new hire the one-page agenda once IT confirms device shipping. :white_check_mark:
